title: Embedding AI: The Questions Every CEO is Asking

reader_summary.headline: It is not true that language models make search engines unnecessary, if anything, they make the search engines more valuable.
reader_summary.overview: It is not true that language models make search engines unnecessary, if anything, they make the search engines more valuable. 2020 was a breakout year for AI, as several new tools gained mass adoption. In fact, many have even claimed that ChatGBTBT is the fastest growing app of all time.

key_points.text: It is not true that language models make search engines unnecessary, if anything, they make the search engines more valuable.
key_points.evidence_quote: It is not true that language models make search engines unnecessary, if anything, they make the search engines more valuable, because now all that data that you can search becomes, like, 10x more powerful.

key_points.text: And despite machine learning being embedded in many applications already, for millions of users, these tools felt like their first real-world encounter with AI.
key_points.evidence_quote: And despite machine learning being embedded in many applications already, for millions of users, these tools felt like their first real-world encounter with AI.

key_points.text: And that's because tools like ChatGBT or Mid-Journey have put AI at the forefront.
key_points.evidence_quote: And that's because tools like ChatGBT or Mid-Journey have put AI at the forefront.

key_points.text: But looking ahead, that may not be the case.
key_points.evidence_quote: But looking ahead, that may not be the case.

thesis: The episode argues that language models enhance search engines by making searchable data more powerful and that AI alone is insufficient for long-term user retention; instead, companies must embed AI to solve core customer problems and differentiate themselves. The discussion highlights that while AI can automate existing processes, a more creative approach leverages unstructured data from customer interactions to gain deep market insights, improve products, and transform high-stress roles like contact center jobs into opportunities for mastery and creativity.
